main_argument_chains.claim: The Maldives should begin moving to Malaysia in 2044, at no more than 80,000 people a year, with the bill charged to the G20 in proportion to emissions reduced by recent cuts.
support_steps: Fit the rise to temperature and time, and convert it to drowned land and people
Price the cultural loss from heritage, tourism and product
Rank hosts by an eight-indicator match
Cap intake where electoral stress crossed a line
Schedule by monotonicity and split the bill with an incentive term
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Start seven years before the islands are uninhabitable, and keep a separate shelter rule for shocks that arrive faster than preparation allows.
